prior_status: The complete tensor no-go family had a joint H/I payment, but the proof used support width and a positive linear outer-influence density; no general slice-pair theorem was available.
mathematical_delta: Replaced support counting by an exact spectral-sector chain rule and coherent Jensen-Shannon payment. Proved a dimension-, bias-, disagreement-, and influence-density-independent C->C+8 FEI closure for every genuine Boolean endpoint pair and every genuine Boolean selector on a fresh disjoint block.

verification.scope: Finite controls support but do not replace the analytic all-dimensional proof.

previous_bound: H(F_k)<=(1728/595)I(F_k) only for one explicit tensor/point-defect family.
new_bound: H(F)<=(C+8)I(F) for every disjoint Boolean slice composition whose two endpoints and selector each satisfy FEI with constant C.
remaining_obstacle: Naive recursion recharges the additive tax at every depth. Prove a one-use telescope for sum_v w_v[2 delta_v h2(beta_v)+8 beta_v h2(r_v)] from source influence/terminal reserve, and then survive selector/data variable overlap.
next_action: Freeze an actual adaptive nonreusing slice hierarchy and test whether the weighted disagreement term delta_v h2(beta_v) is a boundary martingale decrement; if it is not, construct a genuine Boolean hierarchy falsifier while retaining the selector-activation payment beta_v h2(r_v).
